column1: # 1A floor corrections (PLAN.md r46a §3.2; plan-delta item 18, TD D47-D53): the 3,331-name floor of 74d0c72fd was a
# scan of source names, so it counted tests that no test root of upstream's own tree reaches on Windows. These are
# errors in the floor, not absences on the branch. Evidence per kind, at 74d0c72fd in a clean worktree on this
# Windows workstation (R1A, 2026-11-22): filtered runs of `zig build test` and `zig build test-lib-vt -Demit-lib-vt=true`;
# a filter that matches nothing gives 68 and 51 (the unnamed test blocks), the reached font.Glyph.test.Constraints
# gives 69 and 53, and a kind's token gives the empty count when no root reaches it. Read with the build graph.
